skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature of investment activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize and understand the essence of investment activities and development investments, their roles in the economy.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing the nature of investment capital
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize, understand, and analyze the nature of investment capital, various types of investment capital from the perspective of the economy and business.
Understand and apply concepts, principles, contents, methods, tools for managing investment activities and planning investment activities.
Analyze and evaluate the results and effectiveness of investment activities at different levels such as projects, businesses, industries, regions, and the national economy.
Understand the nature, influencing factors, and role of international investment.
Possess research, analysis, synthesis, and evaluation skills related to investment development activities at different management levels.
Have the ability to study independently, conduct research independently, identify problems, analyze and solve problems related to investment activities.
Be able to collaborate and participate in group activities, work effectively with team members to complete group tasks.
